risk_reasons: applyProposal is the first executor on the Owner Operator: it mutates businesses voice columns under a row lock, and a defect applies the wrong state, applies twice, or applies for another account.

Two new owner mutation routes (POST apply, POST decline) gate on same-origin, writable owner, impersonation rejection and the 404 operator_disabled contract; every check is revalidated inside the Apply transaction.
First flip of OWNER_OPERATOR_ENABLED anywhere (staging only, after merge) — the Sentry rule-11 alert must exist before it.
The Operator screen is the first owner-facing UI on the surface; its polling and recovery paths decide whether a stranded turn spins forever or tells the owner what to do.
goal: A signed-in owner on the Operator screen sends an Operator turn, sees the stored Proposal cards it earned, applies one voice Proposal through applyProposal and reads back a server-written Receipt in the same transaction, or declines it with declineProposal; a repeat Apply returns the stored Receipt, a moved Version token marks the card stale with Refresh plan, and the screen recovers a failed or stranded turn without spinning.
non_goals: Auto-approval Proposals (set_auto_reply_scope, set_veto_window, set_daily_cap), patchAutoApprovalSettingsInTransaction, lockAccount ordering, assertConfirmationProvided, the consequence line, asymmetric friction, expansion cards — slice 2.
Undo from Receipts, createRestoreProposal, clear_location_override, the policy-refused card — post-checkpoint.

Any change to the model schema, the validator, the Context snapshot, the prompt, the catalog's operation set, migration 120, or anything Run A settled (turn claim, fenced completion, idempotency, lease and stall semantics beyond tuning the three constants).
A fix for the stranded-turn open item (OutboxPoller exhaustion hook) or the predecessor-wait/watchdog clock conflict — the screen only surfaces them.

The 'last five posted replies' list in the summary panel; Run B shows the posted-7d count from the conversation summary. The summary panel does NOT import the dashboard DTOs: the architecture pass (H1-D) measured that the payload lacks the posted count and the location list and shapes the rating band wrong; Run A's granular helpers stay the source and spec §14's 'reuse' default is corrected to say so.
Flipping OWNER_OPERATOR_ENABLED in production, or any production alert configuration beyond the rule-11 row this run builds in the Sentry project for each environment.
A Decline reason: Decline records the actor only.
user_visible_behavior: GET /operator renders the Operator screen (Console visual system, inside the authenticated shell) with a conversation region, a composer, a summary panel and three starter actions (Set up replies, Change my tone, Show what needs me); with the flag off the page calls notFound() and neither nav shows the link.

Sending a message POSTs /api/operator/turns with a client-generated conversationId, a clientTurnKey and the selected location; the screen shows 'Preparing your plan' and polls GET /api/operator/turns/:id at 2 s, backing off to 5 s after 30 s, until completed or failed; the conversationId and turnId live in URL state so a refresh resumes the same turn.

A turn still not terminal after 4 minutes shows a timeout notice with 'Keep waiting' and 'Start a new conversation' (new conversationId); a failed turn renders wording per TURN_FAILURE_REASON and, for operator_disabled or a 404 operator_disabled from any route, the screen says the Operator is not available and stops polling.

Under the 'All locations' scope the composer is disabled and an inline location chooser is shown; choosing sets the existing location scope and enables the composer. No turn is ever posted without one stored location.

Each stored Proposal renders a card from its row: the catalog describer, the target rendered from the turn's stored location and the proposal's scope (never from the browser's selector), exact before and after of the full voice state, 'Future drafts only. Existing drafts and pending approvals are not rewritten.', and Apply and Not now buttons; when the browser's current scope differs from the stored location the card carries the note 'Prepared for <location>'.

Apply POSTs /api/operator/proposals/:id/apply with { expectedVersionToken } and the card re-renders with the Receipt (operation, scope, before, after actual, effective now, affects, applied at, actor, the verbatim owner text and the turn id); the card's label becomes the applied label.

A repeat Apply on an applied Proposal returns the stored Receipt and executes nothing; Apply on a Proposal whose Version token no longer matches (a form write or another Apply on the same location) marks it stale, and the card says 'Your settings changed after this plan was prepared' with a Refresh plan action that posts a new turn from the original owner text.

Apply on a Proposal whose contract_version is not the catalog's is rejected with contract_changed before any lock and the card says the plan must be regenerated; Apply on a Proposal of another account is 404; Apply from an impersonated session is 409 impersonation_not_allowed; Apply or Decline with a missing or mismatched Origin is rejected before any read.

Every /api/operator route sits behind the owner-API AAL2 gate in proxy branch 6: /api/operator joins isProtectedOwnerApiRoute (one allowlist entry, no new proxy branch), so an owner under MFA enforcement answers the same 403 on an Operator route as on /api/settings (architecture pass 2026-09-12, H1-A).

Not now POSTs /api/operator/proposals/:id/decline; the Proposal becomes rejected with decided_by_user_id set and no reason, and the card shows 'Not applied'. A superseded card shows 'Replaced by a newer plan'.
A Requested capability renders as a card with the normalized request, 'RepWorth cannot do this yet. Nothing changed.', and no button.

The summary panel shows Waiting for you, Recently completed (posted in the last 7 days) and Current operating rules from the conversation GET's summary, each with its as-of timestamp; with no turns yet the GET scopes the summary to the selected location passed as ?locationId=; the summary carries the location's connectionStatus (latest zernio_connections row, account-scoped through businesses) and when it is not active the panel shows the existing connect call to action linking to /dashboard/connect.
Browser evidence at 390 px and 1440 px for the happy path, a failed turn, a stale card and a rejected Apply, with the stored row state asserted behind each.
On staging with the flag on, the checkpoint report in spec §12.1 records p50 and p95 turn latency and the tuned lease, stall and wait constants.
invariants: #3 Nothing posts to Google and no auto_approval_policies row changes: Apply changes voice settings only, through updateVoiceConfig, and a conversation is never an approval token — only the recorded owner click on one Proposal id, revalidated inside the transaction, applies anything.

#13/#14 OWNER_OPERATOR_ENABLED has no NEXT_PUBLIC companion; the screen learns the flag from the server page and from the 404 operator_disabled contract; auto-approval policy access stays server-owned.
#15 Every module under src/lib/agents/operator receives sql or tx explicitly; only the routes and pages import the singleton.

Authorization at every boundary: POST apply and decline run withSameOrigin, requireWritableOwner and the impersonation rejection; Apply revalidates actor, subscription, offboarding, tier, ownership, status and the Version token inside sql.begin with the businesses row and the proposal row locked first (voice scope: businesses FOR UPDATE, then the proposal FOR UPDATE).

Receipts are server-written in the same transaction as the mutation; there is no committed mutation without a Receipt and no Receipt without a committed mutation; the client never supplies any Receipt field.
The Version token is compared text to text ({ businessId, updatedAt } with updatedAt from updated_at::text); current, prepared and expected must all be equal or the Proposal is stale.
No review text, response text or reviewer name reaches the model: Run B adds no model input; the Receipt and cards are owner-facing reads only.
The model schema still has no field for a count, an approval, a confirmation or a Receipt (schema.test.ts pins it; Run B does not touch OperatorModelOutputSchema).
Every SQL statement over agent_proposals carries an account_id predicate (ci:tenant-scope), and the two new routes answer 404 for another account's Proposal exactly as GET turn does.

The Apply executor writes only the operation's own fields through the shared voice writer; sibling pending Proposals on the same location are marked stale in the same transaction, so approved intent is never rewritten silently.
Structured logs and Sentry events carry ids only — never owner text, a Receipt, a segment or a Proposal body.
edge_cases: Repeat Apply on an applied Proposal: the transaction locks, sees status applied, returns the stored Receipt, writes nothing.
Two concurrent Applies on one Proposal: both lock the businesses row; the second sees status applied and returns the first's Receipt.

Two pending Proposals on one location, Apply the first: the write moves businesses.updated_at, the second's token no longer matches and it is marked stale in the same transaction; its card says why and offers Refresh plan.

A settings-form PUT between preparation and Apply: the current token differs from prepared; status stale, failure_reason version_mismatch, no mutation, the state change commits, route answers 409 proposal_stale with the stored row.
Client sends an expectedVersionToken that differs from the stored prepared token while the row is unchanged: treated as a miss per spec §6.4 step 3 — stale, no mutation.
contract_version differs from the catalog's: rejected with failure_reason contract_changed, written without any lock, route answers 409 contract_changed; the card shows the regenerate wording.
Proposal of another account, a malformed id, or an unknown id: 404 proposal_not_found from both routes, indistinguishable.
Apply on a stale, rejected, superseded or failed Proposal: 409 proposal_not_pending carrying the current status; nothing written.

Decline on a pending Proposal: status rejected, decided_by_user_id set, failure_reason NULL; Decline again: 200 with the same row (idempotent); Decline on an applied Proposal: 409 proposal_not_pending.
Actor no longer writable at Apply (past_due beyond grace, cancelled, offboarding blocked, role changed): rejected with failure_reason unauthorized or account_offboarding, no mutation.
The location was archived after preparation: the businesses lock read (archived_at IS NULL) returns no row; rejected with failure_reason location_not_found, no mutation.
The committed voice state differs from the stored after (a concurrent trigger or a seeded column): the Receipt's after is the actual state and differsFromPreview is true; status is still applied.
The executor throws (constraint, connection loss): the transaction rolls back mutation and Receipt together; the route answers 500 apply_failed; a retry finds the Proposal still pending.
Turn stranded accepted (outbox exhaustion, spec §14 CA1): the screen's 4-minute timeout offers 'Start a new conversation', which has no predecessor and therefore does not wait on the stranded turn.
Turn failed predecessor_stalled: the card explains an earlier message did not finish and offers 'Start a new conversation'.

Flag flipped off while the screen is open: the next poll or POST returns 404 operator_disabled; the screen shows the not-available notice and stops polling; the page itself returns the not-found page on the next navigation.

Selector moved after a turn was accepted: the card names the stored location and shows 'Prepared for <location>'; Apply still targets the stored location; the summary panel stays scoped to the latest turn's location.

Multi-location owner under 'All locations': the composer is disabled with an inline chooser; the conversation GET without turns is called with ?locationId= only once a location is chosen, otherwise the panel shows the chooser hint.
Secondary location: a turn submitted with the secondary location stored builds its cards and summary for that location even when the browser selection moves before Apply.
Refresh during Preparing your plan: URL state carries conversationId and turnId; the page resumes polling the same turn; a resent message with the same clientTurnKey returns the same ids.
Google connection missing: the summary panel shows the existing connect call to action; the composer stays enabled (the turn is a settings conversation, not a posting action).
Receipt JSONB read back through PgBouncer as a string: the single parse site in schema.ts guards typeof string, narrows with the Receipt zod schema and throws on a shape no writer produces.
Sibling-stale marking never touches Proposals of another location or another account.
Rule 11: the Sentry alert exists in both Sentry projects before the staging flip; the runbook triage step reads outbox_id → job_outbox.payload → agent_turns.status.

Authenticated Playwright flows self-skip in CI (the auth harness env is local-only, e2e/harness.ts); the unauthenticated redirect assertion runs in CI, the signed-in flows run locally against the harness, and the worker is stood in for by SQL fixtures that complete a seeded turn (e2e/helpers/operator-seed.ts).

rollback_plan: Code: revert the PR. OWNER_OPERATOR_ENABLED stays off in production, so no route or page is reachable there. Staging: set OWNER_OPERATOR_ENABLED=false on both Railway and Vercel staging (the flag-flip skill's reverse step) — the routes 404 and the page returns not-found; any applied Receipt stays as history in agent_proposals and the voice columns keep the applied values, which the owner can change on the settings form. Schema: none. Alerting: the rule-11 Sentry alert can stay; it fires only on agent_turn exhaustion.
observability: agent_proposals.status, failure_reason, decided_by_user_id, applied_at and receipt distinguish applied, stale (version_mismatch), rejected (owner decline: NULL reason; contract_changed; unauthorized; account_offboarding; location_not_found) and failed.
Structured route logs for apply and decline carry proposal_id, account_id and the result kind; never the receipt body.
Sentry rule 11 (subsystem:worker_job AND queue:agent_turn) exists in both projects before the staging flip and is recorded with its rule id in the runbook.
The six domain terminal reasons stay structured logs only (decision recorded in spec §14 and the runbook); the checkpoint report reads their distribution from agent_turns.failure_reason on staging.
Checkpoint: p50 and p95 turn latency on staging computed from agent_turns.created_at to completed_at with the flag on.
